basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. One original production avatar tile for an ecommerce desktop app's workflow cards. Match the friendly illustrated expert directory look: a personable, stylized, slightly big-headed professional with a single unmistakable business prop, like a polished contemporary East Asian editorial character sticker. Square 1:1 full-bleed pastel color all the way to the four corners. The app rounds the corners. Clean expressive dark navy/chestnut linework, simple cel shading, restrained highlights, thoughtfully shaped hair and clothing, warm face and defined silhouette. Close crop from chest up, big head, engaging 3/4 or frontal pose with the dominant prop raised near one shoulder, face and prop legible even at 48 pixels, centered with a little breathing room. Gently deeper tonal disc behind the subject if helpful. Keep it crisp and graphic. One character, one prop. No writing, numbers, letters, UI chrome, logos, watermark, outer frame, multiple panels or busy scene.
